title: A Hierarchical Edge Control Plane for Policy-Aware Multi-Module AI Orchestration
abstract_snippet: Edge deployments of multi-model AI perception pipelines face orchestration challenges that are largely independent of individual model accuracy. Dynamic coordination of heterogeneous inference pipelines subject to shared latency, computational, and policy constraints presents a control theory challenge. The tight coupling of such systems can create cascading fault conditions in the perception pipe...
